title: Spain demands that TikTok suspend operations until child sexual abuse material gone
summary: Spain's Youth Minister Sira Rego appeals to prosecutors and the Data Protection Agency to take action against the social media company

blocks.text: TIKTOK. Teenagers pose for a photo while holding smartphones in front of a TikTok logo in this illustration taken September 11, 2025
Spain's Youth Minister Sira Rego appeals to prosecutors and the Data Protection Agency to take action against the social media company

MADRID, Spain – Spain’s government has demanded that TikTok suspend its operations in Spain until it eliminates child sexual abuse material, it said on Tuesday, November 10, after a media report documented 1,183 explicit posts on the platform with millions of views.

Youth Minister Sira Rego, whose ministry cannot singlehandedly ban the platform in Spain, has appealed to prosecutors and the Data Protection Agency to take action against the social media company, according to a statement by the ministry.
“Social media cannot be lawless territory,” Rego said.

The request comes months after Sanchez’s government requested a probe into X, Meta, and TikTok for allegedly spreading AI-generated child sexual abuse material, as European regulators intensify scrutiny of big tech over harmful and illegal content.
TikTok did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

Spanish fact-checking nonprofit Maldita.es on Monday published an investigation revealing that videos of explicit child sexual abuse had been viewed on the platform at least 48 million times, with over 26,000 profiles commenting on and sharing the material.

The organization published a follow-up story on Tuesday evening stating that TikTok had restricted two of the search terms that Maldita.es’s investigation identified as pathways to child sexual abuse content for users in Spain, but that searches from other European countries still led to the same content. – Rappler.com
